# ZeroDay

> Autonomous vulnerability detection and verified remediation platform for Python web applications. Built with NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory and Tavily threat intelligence grounding for the Nebius × NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon 2026.

ZeroDay pairs an autonomous Red Team Adversary Agent (which discovers vulnerability sinks via Abstract Syntax Tree analysis and reproduces them using synthetic proof-of-concept exploits) with a Blue Team Healer Agent (which synthesizes minimal unified diff patches using NVIDIA Nemotron). Every patch is independently validated by a Deterministic 4-Gate Invariant Oracle (syntax compilation, static delta, exploit replay rejection, regression test suite).

## Core Capabilities

- **AST Sink Reconnaissance**: Deep static analysis mapping dangerous query execution, unsanitized path joins, and missing authorization decorators across 14 CWE categories.
- **Threat Intelligence Grounding**: Live retrieval of MITRE CWE definitions and OWASP mitigation cheat sheets via Tavily AI Search.
- **Isolated Adversarial Reproduction**: Synthetic ASGI test probes executed in isolated subprocess sandboxes to prove real-world exploitability.
- **Nemotron Patch Synthesis**: Targeted unified diff generation via `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B` hosted on Nebius Token Factory.
- **4-Gate Verification Oracle**: Eliminates AI hallucination by requiring real compilation, static delta verification, exploit rejection, and pytest test suite success before accepting a patch.

## Technical Specifications

- **Inference Runtime**: Nebius Token Factory (`https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/`)
- **Primary Model**: `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B`
- **Benchmark Model**: `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b`
- **Threat Grounding Provider**: Tavily Search API
- **Supported Vulnerability Classes**: CWE-89 (SQLi), CWE-78 (Command Injection), CWE-22 (Path Traversal), CWE-284/CWE-639 (IDOR), CWE-502 (Deserialization), CWE-918 (SSRF), CWE-798 (Hardcoded Secrets), CWE-328 (Weak Cryptography), CWE-601 (Open Redirect), CWE-942 (Permissive CORS), CWE-489 (Debug Endpoints), CWE-614 (Insecure Cookies), CWE-1395 (Vulnerable Dependencies), CWE-20 (Improper Input Validation).
